seoTitle: Atlanta Public Schools Calendar 2027-2028: Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Verified Atlanta Public Schools 2027-2028 student calendar with Aug 2 first day, May 26 last day, fall break, winter break, spring break, early release, PDF and ICS.
heroSummary: Atlanta Public Schools begins the 2027-2028 school year on Monday, August 2, 2027. The final student day is Friday, May 26, 2028. Fall Break runs Oct 12-15, 2027, Winter Break runs Feb 22-25, 2028, and Spring Break runs Apr 3-7, 2028.
calendarNotes: The official APS 2027-2028 student calendar lists 180 instructional days, with 88 days in the first semester and 92 days in the second semester. Students start on August 2, 2027 and finish on May 26, 2028. The calendar includes a PreK-12 Early Release Day on September 20, Teacher Professional Learning Days on October 11, November 2, January 3, February 21, and March 20, plus Fall Break, Thanksgiving Break, December Break, Winter Break, and Spring Break. Families should note that January 3 is a staff-focused return date before students begin the second semester on January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Atlanta Public Schools start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Atlanta Public Schools starts the 2027-2028 school year on Monday, August 2, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is APS Fall Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Tuesday, October 12 through Friday, October 15, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for Atlanta Public Schools in 2027-2028?
calendarFaqs.a: December Break runs December 20-31, 2027. Students begin the second semester on Tuesday, January 4, 2028 after a Teacher Professional Learning Day on January 3. APS also lists Winter Break from February 22-25, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Atlanta Public Schools Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 3 through Friday, April 7, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: Does APS have early release in 2027-2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official APS calendar lists a PreK-12 Early Release Day on Monday, September 20, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in the APS 2027-2028 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official APS 2027-2028 calendar lists 180 instructional days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Atlanta Public Schools in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Friday, May 26, 2028.
